target_customer: Consumer facing on-chain apps such as prediction markets, perpetual exchanges, DeFi protocols and fintechs that need to accept crypto deposits.
problem: Accepting deposits across many chains and tokens is complex for app teams, involving routing, gas and compliance. Unifold offers an API and SDK that handles the full deposit flow.
business_model: Developer API and SDK, likely usage based; pricing not found

founders.name: Timothy Chung
previous_startups: Streambird (wallet as a service, acquired by MoonPay)

founders.name: Quang Huynh
previous_startups: Co-founded a web2/web3 wallet and authentication startup that was acquired (per YC page)

competitors.name: LI.FI Smart Deposit Addresses
competitors.what: Single deposit address that swaps and routes across chains, enterprise only
competitors.traction_then: limited to same chain EVM swaps and EVM to EVM transfers

competitors.name: MoonPay, Transak, Alchemy Pay
competitors.what: On-ramp and payment providers named as direct competitors by a W26 tier list site

technical_complexity.rationale: Cross chain routing, gas abstraction and compliance across web, mobile SDKs is standard but broad engineering with hard integration parts.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations create some stickiness but routing providers such as LI.FI offer similar features and the layer is copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Too early to tell; no incumbent action found as of 2026.

market_need_then: Growth of prediction markets and consumer on-chain apps in 2026 created demand for simple multi chain deposits; the team points to live deposits during Super Bowl LX (secondary source).

identity.visual_style: Clean, modern, with network and token icons
identity.voice_and_tone: Direct and developer oriented; tagline One stack. Every chain. Zero complexity.

brand_strength.rationale: Professional but generic fintech infrastructure branding; no press on the brand.

outcome_analysis: Unifold is an active Winter 2026 company with founders who previously built and sold Streambird to MoonPay. It has a Robinhood Ventures investment announced August 2026 and early prediction market traction, though no outcome can be judged yet; routing competitors are the main risk.
notes: Aggregators (CB Insights, VCBacked) report about $500K total, labeled seed or pre-seed; single sourced and unverified so not recorded as a round. The Robinhood Ventures post gives no amount or stage so the round stage is other. YC page lists Hau Chu as completing a Cornell Tech master's. One aggregator places HQ in Dover; YC says New York City. The LI.FI source is undated.
